confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Lima price levels for July 2026. No live menus, listings, or price pages were checked, and no web sources were used for the anchors; the only searches were for the RBA FX observation. Restaurant and cafe anchors are the most reliable. Hostel and hotel rates vary widely by district and season and are the least certain. Cocktail and wine_glass rest mainly on direct knowledge of pisco sour and restaurant wine prices, cross-checked against beer (roughly 1.8 times beer and 1.5 times beer respectively). Anchors assume a broadly stable sol-dollar rate.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is general South American capital price levels, with Lima treated as a moderate-cost regional capital whose ordinary restaurant and budget accommodation prices sit below Santiago's.
